svg.title: Put a small permitted wood campfire completely out
svg.desc: A working extinguishment flowchart only for the small permitted wood campfire described in the chapter. Never apply its water-turn-touch method to a leaking or burning stove, gas or pressurised canister, liquid fuel, electrical item or cooking fat; move away, call triple zero, warn others and follow exact product or emergency-service directions. If extinguishing water becomes insufficient, remain only while safe: a spreading fire, threatened exit or any other danger means move away first, then call triple zero or use satellite SOS or a personal locator beacon. If remaining is safe, do not leave or cover the fire with soil; seek help and keep signalling. Otherwise repeat the water, turn, look, listen and near-hand checks until every stated cold condition passes.
svg.text: Put the small wood campfire completely out
WOOD CAMPFIRE ONLY — EMERGENCY OVERRIDE
Fire spreading or exit threatened: move first; then 000, SOS or PLB.
Water-turn-touch applies only to the small permitted wood fire.
Never use on stove, gas canister, liquid fuel, electrical item or fat.
For those: move away, call 000, follow exact emergency directions.
80% wording confidence; 10 L minimum, not a guaranteed dose.
1 STOP, TURN AND SOAK
Stop adding fuel well before sleep, leaving or another task.
Turn material inside the fireplace without scattering it.
Pour water slowly over every coal and partly burned piece.
Stir and turn the wet material, then add more water.
Keep your face and body clear of steam.
2 WATER → TURN → LOOK, LISTEN AND NEAR-CHECK
Add water. Stir and turn every part inside the fireplace.
Look and listen for smoke, steam or hissing.
Without touching ash or coal, hold a hand near every turned part.
Heat, smoke, steam or hissing means the fire is NOT OUT.
Keep checking newly exposed material, not only the surface.
HEAT, SMOKE, STEAM OR HISSING?
Check every turned part
YES
ENOUGH WATER READY?
Usable vessel(s) beside the fire
or an immediately usable hose
Water must be deliverable now.
YES: RETURN TO STEP 2
NO
WATER IS INSUFFICIENT
REMAIN ONLY WHILE SAFE.
Spread, threatened exit or other danger: MOVE FIRST.
Then call 000, use satellite SOS or a PLB.
If staying is safe: do not leave or cover with soil.
Call 000: say you cannot put the fire out.
No contact: keep people and fuel away; signal.
Do not declare it out. This branch cannot lead to OUT.
NO
3 NO SIGNS? MAKE THE FINAL
NEAR-CHECK, THEN LIMITED TOUCH CHECK
Turn everything again and near-check every part for heat.
Only after no nearby heat, cautiously touch the wet ash and
visibly unburnt wood to confirm they are cool.
Never touch coal, charred material or anything that may be hot.
Any warmth or doubt means the fire is not out.
ANY WARMTH OR DOUBT?
A doubtful fire is not out
YES — CHECK WATER
NO
FIRE COMPLETELY OUT
Near-check: no heat. Wet ash and unburnt wood: cool.
ONLY NOW MAY YOU LEAVE
WORKING DRAFT — NOT FIELD-APPROVED
